label: Phone sharing
description: Calendars, contacts, and Android alarms shared by the NeoAgent phone app.

apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: Every calendar on the phone (Google, Outlook, iCloud, Exchange), shared by the NeoAgent app.

apps.label: Contacts
apps.description: The contacts on the phone, shared by the NeoAgent app.

apps.label: Alarms
apps.description: The next alarm clock registered on an Android phone.

connectPrompt: Open NeoAgent on your phone to connect it.

tools.name: phone_list_alarms
tools.description: List the next shared Android alarm and recently due alarms. When multiple Alarms accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Alarms account email or identifier.

tools.name: phone_list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars on the connected phone and whether each can be written to. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: phone_list_events
tools.description: List events from the phone's calendars. Defaults to the next 7 days. Covers 30 days back to 90 days ahead. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

query.description: Text to find in title, location, notes or attendees.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: phone_create_event
tools.description: Create an event on the phone. It syncs on to the calendar's account (Google, Outlook, iCloud). When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

calendar_id.description: Writable calendar from phone_list_calendars. Defaults to the primary one.

start.description: Start as an ISO datetime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events.

end.description: End as an ISO datetime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: phone_update_event
tools.description: Change an event on the phone. Only the fields given change. When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

start.description: Start as an ISO datetime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events.

end.description: End as an ISO datetime, or YYYY-MM-DD for all-day events.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: phone_delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event from the phone (every occurrence of a repeating event). When multiple Calendar accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Calendar account email or identifier.

tools.name: phone_search_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts on the phone by name, email, phone number or organization. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

query.description: Text to look for. Empty lists the first contacts.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.

tools.name: phone_create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact to the phone. When multiple Contacts accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Contacts account email or identifier.
